projects.title: Open-Care
projects.description: Open-source healthcare-information platform with searchable doctor, hospital, ambulance, blood-donation, and medical-resource capabilities. Spring Boot REST API with PostgreSQL, Redis, Keycloak-based authorization, MinIO file storage, Liquibase migrations, and Swagger/OpenAPI documentation.

projects.title: FactLens
projects.description: Full-stack editorial platform for publishing and managing news and fact-focused content. Built and deployed the Next.js frontend, Strapi backend and content APIs, PostgreSQL database, and Cloudflare file storage.

projects.title: Election Management System
projects.description: Backend delivery for a distributed Election Management System comprising nearly 25 services. Responsible for API contracts, nomination lifecycle and payment-linked workflows, a reporting service generating official PDF reports, RabbitMQ integration, and Keycloak-based authorization across sensitive election data.

projects.title: Exam Management System
projects.description: Led development of a production exam management system supporting 2,500+ administrators, 1,000 exam invigilators, and registration for nearly 30,000 students. Reduced response time by 30% with Redis caching. Includes Crystal Reports integration and a Flutter mobile interface.
